nodes.description: address private _owner; owner of the KingOfTheJungle contract, set in Ownable constructor and checked by onlyOwner
mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned; reflection balances used by tokenFromReflection and _transferStandard
mapping(address=>uint256) _tOwned; declared token balances mapping (unused in transfer path)
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances; ERC20 allowances written by _approve and read by transferFrom/allowance
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedFromFee; accounts exempt from tax, read in _transfer takeFee decision
mapping(address=>bool) public _isExcludedMaxTxAmount; set by excludeFromMaxTxAmount but never consulted in _transfer
uint256 _rTotal; total reflections, reduced in _reflectFee and read by _getCurrentSupply
uint256 _tFeeTotal; accumulated token fees, increased in _reflectFee
uint256 _redisFeeOnBuy; redistribution fee applied on buys, set by setFee
uint256 _taxFeeOnBuy; marketing/team tax applied on buys, set by setFee
uint256 _redisFeeOnSell; redistribution fee applied on sells, set by setFee
uint256 _taxFeeOnSell; marketing/team tax applied on sells, set by setFee
uint256 _redisFee; currently active redistribution fee read inside _transfer/_getValues
uint256 _taxFee; currently active tax fee read inside _transfer/_getValues
mapping(address=>bool) public bots; blacklist consulted in _transfer and written by blockBots/unblockBot
mapping(address=>uint256) public _buyMap; declared buy-tracking map (unused in logic)
address payable _developmentAddress; hardcoded privileged address used in manualswap/manualsend authorization
address payable _marketingAddress; hardcoded address receiving ETH via sendETHToFee
IUniswapV2Router02 uniswapV2Router; router used for swaps in swapTokensForEth
address uniswapV2Pair; LP pair created in constructor, drives buy/sell branch in _transfer
bool tradingOpen; gate that must be enabled by setTrading before non-owner transfers
bool inSwap; lockTheSwap guard written by swapTokensForEth and read in _transfer
bool swapEnabled; toggled by toggleSwap, gates automatic swap in _transfer
uint256 _maxTxAmount; per-transaction cap enforced in _transfer, set by setMaxTxnAmount
uint256 _maxWalletSize; wallet balance cap enforced in _transfer, set by setMaxWalletSize
uint256 _swapTokensAtAmount; contract-balance threshold triggering auto swap, set by setMinSwapTokensThreshold
KingOfTheJungle constructor: assigns _rOwned owner, deploys Uniswap pair and sets exclusions
ERC20 transfer(address,uint256); forwards to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender
ERC20 approve(address,uint256); calls internal _approve
ERC20 transferFrom(address,address,uint256); transfers then decrements allowance via sub
ERC20 balanceOf(address); returns tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account])
airdrop(address,uint256) onlyOwner; removes fees, transfers amount*10**9, restores fees
internal airdropInternal(address,uint256); calls _transfer with fees removed/restored
airdropArray(address[],uint256[]) onlyOwner; loops calling airdropInternal over holders
private _transfer(address,address,uint256); core logic with trading gate, blacklist, max tx/wallet limits, auto swap and fee selection
private swapTokensForEth(uint256) lockTheSwap; approves router and swaps tokens for ETH using block.timestamp deadline
private sendETHToFee(uint256); forwards ETH to _marketingAddress via .transfer
external manualswap(); requires caller equals development or marketing address, then swaps contract balance
external manualsend(); requires caller equals development or marketing address, then sends ETH balance
setTrading(bool) onlyOwner; enables/disables tradingOpen
blockBots(address) onlyOwner; blacklists an address in bots
unblockBot(address) onlyOwner; removes an address from bots blacklist
private _tokenTransfer(address,address,uint256,bool); toggles fees and calls _transferStandard
private _transferStandard(address,address,uint256); computes values, updates _rOwned, effects fees
private _takeTeam(uint256); credits contract _rOwned with team share
private _reflectFee(uint256,uint256); reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal
private view _getValues(uint256); orchestrates _getTValues/_getRate/_getRValues
private pure _getTValues(uint256,uint256,uint256); computes tFee, tTeam, tTransferAmount
private pure _getRValues(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256); computes rAmount, rFee, rTransferAmount
private view _getRate(); returns rSupply.div(tSupply); division-by-zero risk on tSupply
private view _getCurrentSupply(); returns reflection and token supply pair
setFee(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) onlyOwner; writes buy/sell fee state variables
setMinSwapTokensThreshold(uint256) onlyOwner; sets _swapTokensAtAmount
toggleSwap(bool) onlyOwner; sets swapEnabled
setMaxTxnAmount(uint256) onlyOwner; sets _maxTxAmount
setMaxWalletSize(uint256) onlyOwner; sets _maxWalletSize
excludeFromMaxTxAmount(address,bool) onlyOwner; writes _isExcludedMaxTxAmount (not enforced later)
excludeFromFee(address,bool) onlyOwner; writes _isExcludedFromFee
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees(address[],bool) onlyOwner; loop writing _isExcludedFromFee
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner; reassigns _owner
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner; sets _owner to address(0)
private _approve(address,address,uint256); writes _allowances and emits Approval
private removeAllFee(); caches and zeroes _redisFee/_taxFee
private restoreAllFee(); restores cached fee values
private view tokenFromReflection(uint256); converts reflection amount to token amount
receive() external payable {}; accepts ETH sent to the contract
msg.sender / _msgSender(); attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership and transfer authorization
block.timestamp; miner-influenceable time value passed as the Uniswap swap deadline
_marketingAddress.transfer(amount); external ETH value transfer executed inside sendETHToFee
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(...); external call into an untrusted router
IUniswapV2Factory.createPair(...) and router.factory()/WETH() external calls in the constructor
parameter 'from' of _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount)
parameter 'to' of _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount)
parameter 'amount' of _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount)
local 'contractTokenBalance' in _transfer used for the auto-swap threshold check
local bool 'takeFee' in _transfer controlling fee application
parameter 'tokenAmount' of swapTokensForEth(uint256 tokenAmount)
parameter 'amount' of sendETHToFee(uint256 amount)
parameter 'botwallet' of blockBots(address botwallet)
parameter 'amount' of airdrop(address recipient, uint256 amount)
local 'currentRate' in _getRate/_takeTeam obtained from _getCurrentSupply

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the 'from' address when transfer()/transferFrom() invoke _transfer
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against _developmentAddress or _marketingAddress instead of an owner check
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against hardcoded privileged addresses
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender(); control of all administrative setters depends on this comparison
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making swap execution time miner-influenceable
_redisFee is read in _transfer to set the active redistribution fee
_taxFee is read in _transfer to set the active tax fee
_maxTxAmount caps the transferred amount and clamps the contract balance before swapping
_maxWalletSize is used in the balanceOf(to) + amount wallet cap check
_swapTokensAtAmount is the threshold for canSwap in the auto-liquidity branch
bots blacklist is read for both from and to inside _transfer
uniswapV2Pair decides buy/sell fee branches and whether the auto swap executes
_isExcludedFromFee determines takeFee and whether the auto swap may run
inSwap is read to prevent nested swaps during _transfer
swapEnabled gates the automatic swapTokensForEth call
uniswapV2Router is the target of approve and the token swap external call
_marketingAddress is the recipient of the ETH value transfer in sendETHToFee
_rOwned balances are decremented for sender and incremented for recipient in _transferStandard
_rTotal is reduced by the reflection fee in _reflectFee
_rTotal bounds the reflection amount checked in tokenFromReflection
_rTotal is the reflection supply source in _getCurrentSupply
setFee writes the buy redistribution fee _redisFeeOnBuy
setFee writes the buy tax fee _taxFeeOnBuy
setFee writes the sell redistribution fee _redisFeeOnSell
setFee writes the sell tax fee _taxFeeOnSell
onlyOwner setTrading toggles tradingOpen, which gates all non-owner transfers
onlyOwner blockBots adds an address to the bots blacklist
onlyOwner unblockBot removes an address from the bots blacklist
onlyOwner toggleSwap controls swapEnabled and therefore automatic swap execution
onlyOwner setMaxTxnAmount writes the transfer cap _maxTxAmount
onlyOwner setMaxWalletSize writes the wallet cap _maxWalletSize
onlyOwner setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes the swap threshold
excludeFromMaxTxAmount writes _isExcludedMaxTxAmount, which is never read in the transfer path
onlyOwner excludeFromFee changes tax exemption for an account
onlyOwner excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees loops writing _isExcludedFromFee
constructor records _msgSender() as the initial _owner
constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address in uniswapV2Pair
constructor excludes owner, contract, development and marketing addresses from fees
onlyOwner transferOwnership reassigns _owner to an arbitrary new address
onlyOwner renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0)
_transferStandard mutates _rOwned[sender] and _rOwned[recipient]
_takeTeam credits the team share to _rOwned[address(this)]
_reflectFee increases the accumulated _tFeeTotal
_approve writes the _allowances mapping for owner and spender
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] and subtracts the spent amount
_getTValues consumes redisFee to derive tFee and the resulting transfer amount
_getTValues consumes taxFee to derive tTeam
parameter 'from' is the sender address validated and debited inside _transfer
parameter 'to' is the recipient address validated and credited inside _transfer
parameter 'amount' is validated against _maxTxAmount and passed to _tokenTransfer
local contractTokenBalance determines whether swapTokensForEth is invoked
local takeFee selects whether removeAllFee/restoreAllFee are applied
parameter tokenAmount is the amount approved to and swapped through the router
parameter amount is the ETH value forwarded to _marketingAddress
parameter botwallet is the address written into the bots blacklist
parameter amount is scaled by 10**9 and transferred in airdrop
local currentRate is the divisor produced in _getRate
transfer() delegates all transfer logic to _transfer
transferFrom() invokes _transfer before reducing the allowance
approve() delegates to the internal _approve helper
balanceOf() converts _rOwned through tokenFromReflection
_transfer finally calls _tokenTransfer to execute the balance movement
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth when the contract balance crosses the threshold
_transfer sends the contract ETH balance to fees after the swap
manualswap swaps the whole contract token balance for ETH
manualsend forwards the contract ETH balance to the fee address
airdrop removes fees, calls _transfer and restores fees
airdropArray loops calling airdropInternal for each holder
airdropInternal calls _transfer while fees are disabled
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard with the derived takeFee flag
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after the fee-free transfer
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to credit the team portion
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the computed fee amounts
_transferStandard obtains rAmount/rFee/rTransferAmount from _getValues
_getValues calls _getTValues to derive token-side amounts
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current reflection rate
_getValues calls _getRValues to derive reflection-side amounts
_getRate obtains rSupply and tSupply from _getCurrentSupply
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert the team token amount into reflections
sendETHToFee reaches the external ETH value transfer unsafe operation
swapTokensForEth reaches the external router swap unsafe operation
constructor reaches the external factory/router calls that create the trading pair
the router swap is an external call that can re-enter the token contract; the inSwap flag only blocks the auto-swap branch of _transfer, not other entry points
address.transfer returns control to sendETHToFee after sending ETH; the 2300 gas stipend prevents meaningful re-entry

normalization_plan.reason: 'from' exists only as the sender argument consumed by _transfer; its semantics belong to the _transfer core function
'to' exists only as the recipient argument consumed by _transfer and drives the pair/max-wallet checks
'amount' is a transient argument validated inside _transfer before being forwarded to _tokenTransfer
contractTokenBalance is a temporary value computed and used only inside _transfer to trigger the swap
takeFee is a local flag that only routes control inside _transfer and carries no standalone semantics
tokenAmount is the sole argument of swapTokensForEth and is consumed entirely within it
amount is the sole argument forwarded to _marketingAddress inside sendETHToFee
botwallet is only used to key the bots mapping inside blockBots
the airdrop amount is only scaled and forwarded to _transfer within airdrop
currentRate is the transient return value computed inside _getRate and consumed by its callers
